gloss_en: Fascias and wall sweeps keep exporting as IfcBuildingElementProxy despite IfcExportAs and class mapping.
title_original: Fascias and Wall Sweeps not able to override IFC Class from BuildingElementProxy
question_paraphrase: trying to get rid of BuildingElementProxy; set another IFC class in options and used IfcExportAs but fascias and wall sweeps still come out as proxy, any other way?
answer_summary: Community answer: no real fix; expose IfcExportAs/IfcExportType in the user-defined pset file so clients can see you did your best. Autodesk dev later proposed better defaults (gutter=IfcPipeSegment, fascia=IfcCovering).

gloss_en: Floors silently do not export on some PCs even though mapped to IfcSlab; unacceptable for production.
title_original: PR: Floors not exporting
question_paraphrase: floors vanish from IFC although mapped to IfcSlab; invalid class elsewhere falls back to proxy but floors are skipped; works on some PCs not others; no export logs
phrasing_notes: states workarounds are 'unacceptable in a production environment'; asks for debug logs
answer_summary: Autodesk asked for a minimal file; reporters showed an empty 2-floor model reproduces; no log output was the complaint.

gloss_en: Many Revit property units are exported as plain IFCREAL instead of proper IFC measure types, so IFC files will become illegible.
title_original: Systematic(!) RevitIFCUnitBug!
question_paraphrase: many parameter units exported as plain IfcReal rather than suitable unit types; test wall with custom pset, IFC4 Reference View
phrasing_notes: capitals and exclamation, originally a LinkedIn rant, 'THE BUG in short'
answer_summary: Autodesk apologised, said a project is converting missing units but there is no generic Revit-to-IFC unit conversion.

gloss_en: Across 6 architectural IFC files from one project, 2,578 GlobalIds were duplicated across files, breaking linking to other systems.
title_original: Why are GlobalIds not unique across files?
question_paraphrase: sample of 6 arch models, 1.9M rooted elements, 0.136% duplicate GlobalIds, 'pretty severe'; resorts to tricks to regenerate and map IDs
answer_summary: Autodesk: duplicates across files are trivially created by copying a Revit file and re-exporting; never within one file.

gloss_en: Revit meshes fillets into bloated geometry (doors at 17,000 polygons) wasting everyone's time exporting, downloading and re-importing.
title_original: IFC meshing is bloated: can meshing be better optimised, especially where fillets occur?
question_paraphrase: extruded profiles with fillets become FacetedBrep/PolygonalFaceSet with absurd triangle counts; 3x time wasted for exporting, downloading, importing consultant
context_given: osarch wiki on Revit IFC geometry
phrasing_notes: 'wastes time for the consultant exporting, downloading and importing'
answer_summary: Logged internally as Jira REVIT-240334, open.

gloss_en: With project units in mm the BaseQuantities of structural columns (GrossVolume, OuterSurfaceArea) are wrong; fine in metres.
title_original: Incorrect BaseQuantities in Revit 2022.1 (GrossVolume, OuterSurfaceArea, CrossSectionArea)
question_paraphrase: column BaseQuantities wrong when project units are millimetre, correct after switching to metre; plain Quantities unaffected
phrasing_notes: later comment: 'causing some major problems for us and STILL no fix!'
answer_summary: Open for a long time; commenters chased for a fix.

gloss_en: IFC from MicroStation shows elements in other viewers but Navisworks drops some; clash detection becomes useless if not all shown.
title_original: Navisworks doesn't show some IFC elements
question_paraphrase: IFC from Microstation, BIM Collab and DDSCAD show the boxes, Navisworks 2023 doesn't; tried modern and v3 options
answer_summary: Autodesk working on a fix in 23.1 pre-release.

gloss_en: Fabrication ductwork produces hundreds of one-off IfcElementTypes with the Revit element id as tag, defeating the purpose of types.
title_original: Fabrication ductwork generates hundreds of duplicate IfcElementTypes
question_paraphrase: each element type has a single occurrence, identical Tag; can Revit not split types?
answer_summary: Fixed in newer exporter version, which handles fabrication shared geometry differently.

gloss_en: Revit fills IFC ObjectType with Family and Type, which is non-compliant; wants an empty ObjectType unless USERDEFINED.
title_original: ENH: ObjectType export value
question_paraphrase: ObjectType should only be used when PredefinedType is USERDEFINED; Revit duplicates Name; wants empty value if IfcObjectType not filled
answer_summary: Other users agreed and raised the same for Reference property in psets (FamilyName:TypeName).

gloss_en: Revit auto-generates hundreds of IfcBuildingElementProxyTypes (curtain wall profiles) that cannot be edited, so clients see proxies without required data.
title_original: PR: auto-generated building element proxy type
question_paraphrase: auto generated proxy elements each with own proxy type, probably curtain wall reveals; cannot set IfcExportAs
phrasing_notes: 'clients will see a bunch of generic proxy elements missing all the data that they request'
answer_summary: Autodesk asked for a sample file.

gloss_en: We receive MEP IFCs classed only as IfcFlowSegment because consultants cannot or will not be more precise; needs better import class mapping tables.
title_original: ENH: Better handling of import class mapping tables
question_paraphrase: consultants unable or unwilling to give precise classes, so we built several import mapping tables; hard to switch them per received model
phrasing_notes: explains workaround, bullet list of pain
answer_summary: Another commenter wants ExportIFCCategoryTable settable via API for automation.

gloss_en: Using IFC4 many components are skipped, with IFC2x3 everything exports.
title_original: Components are missing when using IFC4
question_paraphrase: with IFC 2x3 everything exports, with IFC 4 a lot is skipped
answer_summary: Autodesk asked whether IFC4 meant Reference View.

gloss_en: Not all type properties from Identity Data are visible in the IFC when exporting all Revit properties.
title_original: Issue with Revit (type) properties not exporting to IFC
question_paraphrase: exporting all Revit properties but some type props of a door family missing in IFC
answer_summary: Autodesk said a local fix existed and would be released.

gloss_en: IFC export with properties is very slow, timings vary wildly; geometry is not the bottleneck.
title_original: Exporting with properties or various settings are extremely slow
question_paraphrase: table of export times by setting; properties cost the most; timings inconsistent
answer_summary: Autodesk: properties API is slow; DTV should not tessellate.

gloss_en: How do I control grid north separately from true north in Revit IFC export? Revit conflates them.
title_original: Revit doesn't differentiate between grid north and true north
question_paraphrase: setting true north on project base point exports it as both map conversion rotation and true north
phrasing_notes: question-then-complaint, 'incorrectly named in Revit for a long time'
answer_summary: Logged as Jira REVIT-245491, open.

gloss_en: Beam system spacing in Pattern pset exported as feet/304.8 for whole-foot values in a millimetre project.
title_original: PR: Beam System spacing exported as feet / 304.8 when the value is a whole number of feet
question_paraphrase: 609.6 mm spacing written as IFCLENGTHMEASURE(0.00656...)
phrasing_notes: very precise bug report with table
answer_summary: Autodesk reproduced in Revit 2026 for both IFC2x3 CV and IFC4 RV.

gloss_en: Manufacturer IFC objects are near 1:1 replicas, even engraved logos; is this harmful and should there be guidelines?
title_original: Opinion about high polygon count in IFC
question_paraphrase: manufacturer models have very high polygon counts; facility manager found fire extinguishers too realistic; IDS limits?
answer_summary: Replies: warn in validation service, LOIN (EN 17412-1) is the proper venue, viewers should handle LOD; IDS v1 deliberately excludes geometry; workaround is a pset of triangle counts checked via IDS.

gloss_en: How to use IFC Name, Reference and ObjectType when Allplan has no type support?
title_original: Correct Use of IFC Name and Reference (deprecated?)
question_paraphrase: architect in Germany asks what goes in Name vs Reference vs ObjectType; Allplan has limited type support
phrasing_notes: detailed, quotes vendor support; reply 'Ooof' about no types in 2026
answer_summary: Name = instance label; Reference deprecated in IFC4.3; vendor limits may force tool reconsideration.

gloss_en: Does my one-page Revit-to-IFC guide for architectural consultants still work; what to request from Archicad users?
title_original: Revit save to IFC guide
question_paraphrase: guide to raise IFC quality from consultants; asks for updates and Archicad equivalent
answer_summary: Settings: dedicated 3D view, IFC4 DTV or 2x3 CV2.0, project base point, export only visible, rooms as spaces, user-defined pset file.

gloss_en: Are MVDs irrelevant to IfcOpenShell? Certification only affordable for big vendors.
title_original: MVDs are irrelevant to IfcOpenShell?
question_paraphrase: IDS serves users, MVD serves vendors; IfcOpenShell implements full schema so MVD irrelevant?
answer_summary: Maintainer: MVDs practically irrelevant for libraries; certification takes years and is costly, being reinvented.

gloss_en: Architects debate Autodesk's stagnation and gaps; open IFC tools can open files Revit struggles with.
title_original: Autodesk Letter v3, this time from the Nordic architecture associations
question_paraphrase: users say Autodesk leaves gaps for add-ons, Revit stagnates; open tools handle IFC that Revit struggles with
phrasing_notes: sardonic, one called the article draft a rant
answer_summary: Plan to write an architect-facing article on Blender/BlenderBIM, FreeCAD, IFC.js and Speckle.

gloss_en: What is the best free IFC viewer that also handles consultants' non-IFC files (DWG, Rhino, SketchUp)?
title_original: What is your favourite gratis IFC viewer?
question_paraphrase: free viewers; overlay models from consultants who are rarely all on IFC
answer_summary: Many viewers named; concern that online viewers upload files.

gloss_en: Depth and Width in Qto_SlabBaseQuantities are swapped vs spec; maintainers say it is debatable.
title_original: Depth and Width in Qto_SlabBaseQuantities are swapped
question_paraphrase: qto function gives width/depth contrary to IFC4.3 definition; slab thickness should be Width
answer_summary: Maintainer: term is ambiguous; relates to a standard improvement issue.

gloss_en: Cannot edit/extend a wall in the Revit sample file exported to IFC.
title_original: BlenderBim - cannot edit wall in imported revit sample file
question_paraphrase: Shift E extend wall deselects, then error on adjust
answer_summary: Wall has IfcMaterialLayerSet inherited from type, not LayerSetUsage on occurrence.

gloss_en: IFC from Archicad shows material in properties but not in Blender material tab.
title_original: Missing materials when importing IFC files generated in Archicad 21
question_paraphrase: some objects missing material in Blender tab though IFC material exists
answer_summary: IFC material and style are different concepts; may not be a bug.

gloss_en: Maintainer lists IfcOpenShell weaknesses: 20s open for 200MB models, slow edits; competitors dispute benchmarks.
title_original: Addressing some core IfcOpenShell issues
question_paraphrase: speed, web support and scalability lag newer libraries
answer_summary: Proposal for shared benchmark suite comparing correctness and speed.

gloss_en: Strange IfcSlab export behaviour with IFC4 DTV.
title_original: PR: Export IfcSlab problem - strange behavior
question_paraphrase: title only: IfcSlab export acts strangely
answer_summary: Not read.

gloss_en: Project north rotation differs between linking an IFC and its .ifc.rvt file.
title_original: PR: Different project north rotations depending on linking in IFC and corresponding .ifc.rvt file
question_paraphrase: title only
answer_summary: Not read.

gloss_en: Material psets for walls/floors with several layers not exported in IFC4.
title_original: Material pset Wall/Floors with several material layers not exported IFC4
question_paraphrase: title only
answer_summary: Not read.

gloss_en: When importing IFC files windows are positioned outside the wall face in 3D.
title_original: PR: When importing IFC files, windows are positioned outside the wall face in the 3D view
question_paraphrase: title only
answer_summary: Not read.

gloss_en: How could each tier of the OpenBIM Pledge be written in plain language as a consultant contract condition?
title_original: The OpenBIM Pledge
question_paraphrase: wants plain-language contract clauses for IFC deliverables
answer_summary: Not read.

gloss_en: Count proxies in the consultant model
prompt: consultant sent this again. how many IfcBuildingElementProxy are in here and what were they in revit
expected_behavior: Count IfcBuildingElementProxy, group by ObjectType/Revit category properties, report counts and likely target classes.

gloss_en: Find duplicate GlobalIds
prompt: check for duplicate GlobalIds in this model, and against the old version if loaded
expected_behavior: List duplicated GlobalIds within file and across loaded files, with element names and classes.

gloss_en: Verify column quantities against geometry
prompt: column volumes in Qto look off, can u compare to actual geometry volume
expected_behavior: Compare Qto_ColumnBaseQuantities GrossVolume with computed geometry volume per column, flag deviations and unit factors.

gloss_en: Find elements with huge triangle counts
prompt: why is this file 600MB?? which elements have crazy triangle counts
expected_behavior: Compute triangles per element/type, list top offenders by class and name, suggest simplification.

gloss_en: Find types with only one occurrence
prompt: list ifc types that are used by just one element, ducts mainly
expected_behavior: Find IfcElementType entities with exactly one occurrence, filtered to duct classes, with counts.

gloss_en: Check ObjectType usage
prompt: is ObjectType filled for anything that isnt USERDEFINED? thats a schema violation right
expected_behavior: List elements with ObjectType set while PredefinedType is not USERDEFINED, summarise by class.

gloss_en: Report true north vs map conversion
prompt: whats the true north and map conversion rotation in this ifc, think revit mixed up grid and true north
expected_behavior: Read IfcMapConversion and TrueNorth, report both angles, eastings/northings, CRS, and flag likely conflation.

gloss_en: Elements without storey
prompt: any elements not assigned to a storey?
expected_behavior: List elements with no spatial containment or aggregate parent, grouped by class.

gloss_en: Compare two deliveries
prompt: compare this delivery with last weeks, what actually changed. consultant says nothing but file is bigger
expected_behavior: Diff by GlobalId: added, removed, modified geometry/properties, summarize per discipline.

gloss_en: Check materials vs styles
prompt: do walls here have IfcMaterial or only colours/styles
expected_behavior: Report per class whether IfcMaterial/LayerSet assigned versus only styled items.

gloss_en: Find plain IfcReal property values
prompt: which psets have values as IfcReal instead of proper length/area types
expected_behavior: Scan property sets for IfcReal nominal values where measure types expected; list pset and property names.

gloss_en: General quality audit
prompt: give me a quality report on this ifc like for a client who says our model is garbage
expected_behavior: Produce summary: proxies, missing psets, empty names, duplicate GUIDs, units, georef, geometry issues, with severity.

gloss_en: Why floors don't export
prompt: floors dont export from revit 2024 only on some pcs, wtf. what should i check
expected_behavior: Suggest checking IFC exporter version mismatch, Export to IFC parameter default vs Yes, class mapping, user config, compare settings.

gloss_en: Write an IFC delivery clause
prompt: how do I put IFC quality in the consultant contract so we stop getting junk models
expected_behavior: Draft requirements: schema/MVD, IDS file, validation report, georef, class rules, naming, with example wording.

gloss_en: IFC vs native
prompt: should I ask consultants for native rvt or IFC? they say ifc is lossy
expected_behavior: Balanced answer on trade-offs, when each suits, and how to verify IFC fidelity.

gloss_en: Reclassify proxies
prompt: turn the proxies named like column or beam into proper IfcColumn/IfcBeam and save a new file
expected_behavior: Change class for matching proxies, keep GUIDs/psets, write new file, report changes.

gloss_en: Check elements missing from viewer
prompt: navis shows less than the ifc has. list elements w/o geometry so i know whats missing
expected_behavior: List elements with no Representation or empty geometry, grouped by class.
